help.introDescription: Follow the guides below in order to set up the school, enroll students, collect fees, and print documents.
help.tip: The school year in the top-right applies to students, enrollments, payments, and reports. Check it before recording any operation.

start.title: Set up the school for the first time
start.description: Without these settings, enrollments and receipts cannot be generated correctly.

steps.title: Enter the school identity
steps.body: In Settings › School info, fill in the name, address, phone, email, and principal. These details appear on every PDF.

steps.title: Add the logo
steps.body: Still under School info, import the logo. It is used in the sidebar, on the home screen, and on printed documents.

steps.title: Choose the school year
steps.body: Select the current year in the top-right selector (for example 2026/2027). All lists are filtered to that year.

steps.title: Create classes and fees
steps.body: In Settings › Class fees, add levels (Class 1, Class 2…) for each section, then enter the annual fee. That amount is used at enrollment.

steps.title: Prepare categories and cashiers
steps.body: In Settings › Categories & cashiers, create payment and expense categories, plus the cashiers who will validate collections.

students.title: Enroll a student
students.description: Enrollment creates both the student file and the record for the current year.

steps.title: Open the form
steps.body: In Students, click “Add student”. A student number is suggested automatically; you can change it before saving.

steps.title: Enter identity and guardian
steps.body: Fill in the name, gender, birth date, neighborhood, then the parent or guardian with their phone. These contacts are also used for reminders.

steps.title: Choose the section and class
steps.body: Select Francophone or Anglophone, then the class. The annual fee preview appears if it was configured in settings.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Submit the form. The student appears in the list and under Enrollments, with a balance equal to the expected fee.

payments.title: Record a payment and print the receipt
payments.description: Each validated payment updates the student balance and can be printed immediately.

steps.title: Select the student
steps.body: In Payments, choose the student in the filter. You can also start from their file (Students › Details) or use the global search at the top (Ctrl+K).

steps.title: Enter the installment
steps.body: Click “New payment”, then enter the date, amount, mode (cash, mobile money…), term if needed, and cashier.

steps.title: Check the balance
steps.body: The preview shows what remains due. After saving, the dashboard and the student statement update.

steps.title: Print the receipt
steps.body: Use the print action on the payment row. The bilingual PDF includes the amount in words, remaining balance, and signature lines.

expenses.title: Record an expense
expenses.description: Validated expenses are deducted from the overall treasury shown on Home and in Finance.

steps.title: Create the expense
steps.body: In Expenses, click “New expense”. Enter the date, category, description, supplier, payment mode, and amount.

steps.title: Edit if needed
steps.body: While the expense is validated, the pencil lets you correct the description or amount. Cancelled expenses can no longer be edited.

steps.title: Export the register
steps.body: Filter by period or category, then export to PDF or Excel for accounting.

staff.title: Manage staff and salaries
staff.description: The staff directory and salary payments live on the same screen.

steps.title: Add a member
steps.body: In Staff, create the file: number, name, role, and monthly salary. The number is generated automatically.

steps.title: Record a salary
steps.body: Open the payments tab, choose the month, type (salary, advance…), and amount. A salary receipt can be printed.

steps.title: Follow unpaid staff
steps.body: Home flags members who have not been paid for the current month. You can also deactivate a member without losing their history.

reports.title: View and print reports
reports.description: Official documents (statement, class roster, financial report) are generated from the matching screens.

steps.title: Student statement
steps.body: In Student report, select the student. You get the payment history, the balance, and a PDF to print or send to the guardian.

steps.title: Remind overdue families
steps.body: The same page lists unpaid balances. A reminder message is prepared; you can copy it for WhatsApp or SMS.

steps.title: Class roster
steps.body: From Enrollments, export the class list as PDF: student numbers, names, amounts paid, and balances.

steps.title: Financial report
steps.body: In Finance, filter the period then print the consolidated report (income, expenses, salaries, net balance).

backup.title: Protect the data
backup.description: The database is local. Regular off-computer backups prevent any loss if the machine fails.

steps.title: Back up now
steps.body: In Settings › Advanced options, click “Back up now”. Choose a folder (USB drive, external disk, or cloud).

steps.title: Enable the reminder
steps.body: Set the reminder interval. Home shows an alert when the last backup is too old.

steps.title: Restore if needed
steps.body: Restore replaces the current database. Only do this from a healthy backup, then restart the application.
